hotels.title: Sri Lanka Beachfront Luxury with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Daily Drink & Spa Treatments
hotels.description: Set on Sri Lanka's pristine southern coastline just two minutes from one of the island's most important sea turtle nesting beaches, Sheraton Kosgoda Turtle Beach Resort pairs direct beach access and a rooftop lounge with sweeping ocean views with Shine Spa's signature Balinese treatments. S Kitchen serves up generous buffet spreads for breakfast and dinner, while the pool bar and rooftop lounge keep things going well into the evening. When the urge to explore strikes, Cinnamon Island is 10 minutes away and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Galle Dutch Fort is just over an hour along the coast.
